snippet.title: The Fifth Bell (chapter2)
snippet.description:
The Fifth Bell is a mystical horror rooted in an ancient legend. Search for five hidden offerings in a fog-covered village while the Reaper hunts you. With every toll of the bell, he comes closer—will you survive the fifth?

Steam Wishlist now https://store.steampowered.com/app/4040030/The_Fifth_Bell/
